mapper.select: /* selectQueueEnabledBatches */ SELECT bat_id AS batId, bat_nm AS batNm, job_class AS jobClass, interval_minutes AS intervalMinutes, last_scheduled_at AS lastScheduledAt FROM sys_batch_config WHERE queue_yn = 'Y' AND use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY sort_sn ASC, bat_id ASC
/* selectSynergyPendingRidRange */ SELECT MIN(replay_id) AS minRid, MAX(replay_id) AS maxRid FROM public.rta_match WHERE synergy_applied_at IS NULL
